description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and memory usage for various models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to slightly beyond 1000, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Memory (GB)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to slightly above 400, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 50. The legend lists five entries, all represented by solid lines with circular markers featuring white borders. The pink line labeled "VideoLLaMB" is not distinctly visible on the plot. The gold line, labeled "VideoLLaMB-R," shows a very gradual, steady increase, starting near x=0 at approximately 18 GB and ending near x=1024 at approximately 38 GB. A green line, whose label in the legend is obscured by a grey rectangle, starts near x=0 at approximately 18 GB and rises steadily to end near x=1024 at approximately 75 GB. The blue line, labeled "LLaVA-NeXT," starts near x=0 at approximately 18 GB and increases steadily to end near x=1024 at approximately 145 GB. Finally, the purple line, labeled "VideoLLAVA," starts near x=0 at approximately 18 GB and exhibits a steep upward trend, reaching approximately 120 GB near x=128 and 230 GB near x=256, before extending beyond the upper limit of the y-axis (400 GB) prior to reaching x=400.
